visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman wearing a black sports bra and a maroon open-front jacket runs away from the camera on a red clay track within a massive professional baseball stadium. She raises her right hand with a finger pointed up in excitement. The stadium lights are extremely bright, illuminating the green grass field and a large digital screen in the background displaying pink and white graphics. (2) The woman runs along the perimeter of the field, high-fiving numerous fans who are reaching through the safety netting from the stands. She is smiling broadly and wearing a maroon baseball cap. A man in a black polo shirt and beige trousers runs closely behind her. The stands are filled with a dense crowd of people in dark clothing. (3) The camera perspective follows the woman as she continues her lap, now joined by a person in a large maroon gorilla mascot costume wearing a baseball jersey. They run together across the red dirt towards the dugout area. Several staff members with cameras and passers-by are visible in the background, along with various advertising boards. (4) The woman finally reaches the green grass of the infield and collapses playfully onto her back, looking exhausted but happy. A man in a black shirt leans over to offer her a hand to help her up. The scene concludes with a close-up of her laughing as she catches her breath on the ground.
